description: Stars a Trello board for a member at a specified position; the board must exist and be accessible to the member.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board to be starred. The board must exist and be accessible to the specified member.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member for whom the board star will be added.
idMember.title: Id Member

pos.description: The desired position for the new board star in the member's list of starred boards. Valid values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive integer.
pos.title: Pos

name: create_member_board_star

id.description: Unique identifier of the board star. A 24-character hexadecimal string (TrelloID).
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: Unique identifier of the board that was starred. A 24-character hexadecimal string (TrelloID).
idBoard.title: Id Board

pos.description: Position value for ordering starred boards. Used to determine the display order of starred boards in the user's interface.
pos.title: Pos
